Final review complete. The single change in src/dotenv/parser.py (line 30) reorders the `_rest_of_line` alternation to `(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?`, matching CRLF as one complete newline and aligning with `_newline` and `_end_of_line`.

Result: On the error-recovery path, the invalid binding's `original.string` now includes the whole CRLF, and the following valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string == "GOOD=ok\n"`. LF and lone-CR behavior are preserved, and repeated invalid lines each consume exactly one terminator. No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were touched.

Host acceptance and selected upstream regression tests passed. No remaining limitations identified; no further edits required.
